meta.label: Intentional homicide rate, by NUTS 3 region (2023)
meta.methodNote: Intentional homicides per 100,000 population, per NUTS 3 region (province-equivalent), OECD's own Regional Statistics database (DSD_REG_SOC@DF_SAFETY, MEASURE=HOMIC), 2023 — the newest year with complete coverage for this map's focus countries before a later reporting-lag drop. Boundaries: github.com/eurostat/Nuts2json, 2021 typology, reused from scripts/etl/eurostat.py rather than re-fetched — OECD's own REF_AREA codes are the same NUTS codes Eurostat uses for EU/EFTA countries (confirmed: all 107 Italian NUTS 3 codes match exactly).
meta.coverageNote: Albania has ZERO codes in this dataset — Albania is not an OECD member, so this is a permanent, structural absence, not a data quality gap like every Eurostat layer's UK/Albania caveats. The UK is only partially covered: 6 UK NUTS 3 regions have a 2023 value that matches this map's NUTS boundaries (2021 typology). OECD codes some UK regions against an older NUTS vintage; those are excluded rather than force-matched. Italy and most other EU/EFTA countries have no such mismatch.
